As Eaton Plc (ETN) Market Valuation Rose, Holder Whalerock Point Partners Has Decreased Position; Sirios Capital Management LP Has Boosted Stake in Csx (CSX)
May 23, 2018 - By Dolores Ford
John Brennan increased its stake in Csx Corp (CSX) by 264.96% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Sirios Capital Management LP bought 1.37M shares as the company’s stock declined 0.55% with the market. The hedge fund run by John Brennan held 1.88M shares of the railroads company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $103.56M, up from 515,820 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Sirios Capital Management LP who had been investing in Csx Corp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $55.56B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.84% or $0.54 during the last trading session, reaching $63.47. About 3.01 million shares traded. CSX Corporation (NYSE:CSX) has risen 18.37% since May 23, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 6.82% the S&P500.
Whalerock Point Partners Llc decreased its stake in Eaton Corp Plc (ETN) by 47.55% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. The institutional investor held 6,150 shares of the technology company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $486,000, down from 11,725 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Whalerock Point Partners Llc who had been investing in Eaton Corp Plc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $34.62B market cap company.
